question: అయాన్ అంటే ఏమిటి?

options.text: ధనాత్మక లేదా ఋణాత్మక ఆవేశం కలిగిన పరమాణువు లేదా పరమాణువుల సమూహం.

solution:
The correct answer is __**ధనాత్మక లేదా ఋణాత్మక ఆవేశం కలిగిన పరమాణువు లేదా పరమాణువుల సమూహం.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An **ion** is an **atom** or a **molecule** that has a **net electrical charge** due to the **loss** or **gain** of one or more **electrons**.
 
• It can consist of a **single atom** (monoatomic) or a **group of atoms** (polyatomic) that act as a single unit with a charge. ***Hence, statement 3 is correct.***
 
• A **neutral atom** contains an equal number of **protons** (positive charge) and **electrons** (negative charge), resulting in a **zero net charge**. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
 
• While an **ion** can be a **charged molecule**, the term **molecule** generally refers to a **neutral group** of atoms held together by chemical bonds. ***Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.***
